cutoff.meaning: The deadline for the outcome to occur.

negative_condition: Before the deadline, the department has not issued a written approval and the application has not become deemed approved (i.e., it is denied, still pending, or deemed approval occurs after the deadline).
positive_condition: Before the deadline, the department has issued a written approval of BP-2214 or the application has become deemed approved under the fifteen-business-day rule.

proof.meaning: A written document from the Building Department approving BP-2214, issued before the deadline.
proof.name: written approval
proof.subject: BP-2214

proof.meaning: The application is deemed approved by operation of law at 5:00 PM on the fifteenth counted business day after acceptance, if no written decision is issued before then.
proof.name: deemed approval

terminal_meaning: Whether, before 5:00 PM on Friday 11 September 2026, the Larkspur County Building Department has issued a written approval of BP-2214 or the application has become deemed approved under the fifteen-business-day rule.
